subject: canonical physical-output cancellation after a verified forward route change
question: Does the exact candidate verify the owned inverse and finish fully compensated when cancellation is requested after a verified output write?

reverify.command: Read docs/observations/evidence/2026-10-29-291-output-compensation-reruns.json, then run the preserved external native driver with the recorded candidate binary in canonical-flat-existing-bus-output-cancel mode.
reverify.expected: After the verified forward transition, cancellation performs the owned inverse, publishes exact independent readback evidence, returns fullyCompensated, and the same-key replay performs no additional write.
reverify.cost: more than ten minutes on the protected fixture with stopped playback

method: Built the recorded candidate products from clean tracked trees and ran the preserved cancellation harness against the protected project. The runner paused at every independent UI boundary. Read-only CUA observations verified the exact project, selected track, stopped transport, absence of a menu or dialog and the terminal physical output. No Logic key, click, save, close or project mutation was sent outside the product request. Each owned server was stopped by closing its stdin and confirming the process disappeared.

observations.what: independent terminal UI readback after the exact-candidate product result
same-key terminal replay after repaired-candidate compensation
independent terminal UI readback after repaired-candidate compensation

conclusion: Runs 28 and 30 preserve the original deadline failure. Run 42 on the repaired exact candidate crossed 1 forward and 1 compensation write boundary, published 1 verified compensation with independent stereo_output readback, retained the fullyCompensated result on replay with 0 additional writes, and exited cleanly. This closes only the measured cancellation slice, not whole issue 291.
limits: One protected project, one track, one host and one locale were measured.
The independent terminal readback proves the visible physical value after the product result; it does not supply the missing product compensation receipt.
The infrastructure-control run did not execute the product and is not counted as a behavioral failure.
The repaired result is one warm protected fixture on one track; it does not generalize the retired-window renewal beyond an exact held main window and one fresh complete read-only census.
The observation does not establish complete graph topology, broader compensation, cross-locale behavior or whole-issue completion.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record measures runtime route transitions, compensation receipts, deadlines and cleanup. It does not claim that a quoted label is shipped in Apple's canonical string corpus.
